title: Breathalyzer sharab ko sunghta nahi, bas ye karta hai 🍺 #shorts
description:
Sensor sharab ki bu ko sunghta nahi! MQ-3 ke andar garam SnO2 hota hai jiski resistance alcohol se gir jaati hai.
Aaj Echo Lab 3D mein MQ-3 ko kholke dekhte hain.
🔥 Heater SnO2 ko 200–500 °C tak garam rakhta hai
⚡ Alcohol aate hi resistance girti hai, A0 voltage badhta hai
🎛️ LM393 aur pot milke D0 ko HIGH se LOW karte hain
⏱️ Warm-up: 5–10 min, pehli baar 24–48 ghante
⚠️ Ye legal ya driving decision ke liye bharosemand nahi hai.
Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D, roz ek sensor kholke samjhenge!
